caption: Attribute Dictionary
description: The attributes the ZeroSOC extension adds to OCSF.
name: dictionary

zerosoc.caption: ZeroSOC
zerosoc.description: The ZeroSOC Framework's attributes of the record that carries it: a Case, an Observation of a Case, or a ticket a Case raised.

candidate_incident_categories.caption: Candidate Incident Categories
candidate_incident_categories.description: The incident categories the Case's alert types propose, each an IC-## identifier of the framework's incident categories.

incident_category.caption: Incident Category
incident_category.description: The Case's incident category, an IC-## identifier of the framework's incident categories. Provisional until the Case is an Incident.

reclassification_pivots.caption: Reclassification Pivots
reclassification_pivots.description: Each change of the Case's candidate incident category, with the evidence that triggered it.

from_category.caption: From Category
from_category.description: The incident category before the change, an IC-## identifier.

to_category.caption: To Category
to_category.description: The incident category after the change, an IC-## identifier.

event_refs.caption: Event References
event_refs.description: The events that triggered the change, by the uid of the related events the Case cites.

entry_path.caption: Entry Path
entry_path.description: How the Case entered the loop: alert, hunt or out-of-band. A hunt or out-of-band Case is a detection false negative by construction.

visibility_gaps.caption: Visibility Gaps
visibility_gaps.description: The required data sources that were not available, each with the check it prevented.

data_source.caption: Data Source
data_source.description: A required data source that was not available.

check_prevented.caption: Check Prevented
check_prevented.description: The check the missing data source prevented.

provenance.caption: Provenance
provenance.description: The playbooks the Case was handled under, the classes of executor that handled it, the capability classes they invoked and the products whose records it was built from.

playbooks.caption: Playbooks
playbooks.description: The playbooks the Case was handled under, each by path and version.

executors.caption: Executors
executors.description: The classes of executor that handled the Case: human, automation or agent.

capability_classes.caption: Capability Classes
capability_classes.description: The capability classes the executors invoked.

products.caption: Products
products.description: The products whose records the Case was built from.

significant.caption: Significant
significant.description: Whether the incident is significant under the NIS2 Directive's test: severe operational disruption or financial loss, or considerable damage to other persons.

cross_border.caption: Cross Border
cross_border.description: Whether the incident has a cross-border effect.

notifications.caption: Notifications
notifications.description: The stakeholder and regulatory notifications the Case requires, and their deadlines.

kind.caption: Kind
kind.description: What the record is for: the kind of a notification, or what a ticket is for.

handover_reason.caption: Handover Reason
handover_reason.description: Why the Case's assignee became a person: crown-jewel, privileged-identity or manual.

watch_until.caption: Watch Until
watch_until.description: Until when the Case's entities are watched after an Insufficient Data or Low-confidence close.

master_case_uid.caption: Master Case UID
master_case_uid.description: On a Case closed as a Duplicate, the open master Case that handles the activity, by the identifier its metadata.correlation_uid holds.

side.caption: Side
side.description: The hypothesis an Observation bears on: Malicious or Benign. Absent where the Observation is context.

timeline.caption: Timeline
timeline.description: Whether the Case Timeline renders the entry.

alert_type.caption: Alert Type
alert_type.description: On an Alert, the framework's alert type it is triaged under: the one its source declares, or the one the executor identifies.
